description: spec §3.9: the probe watch on the recorded pod rows (the case's), its rows on the fronthaul home-ap-24 (2.4G): the stations asked about (never one associated with the pod or with another manager's client row), at most the 32 asked most recently, dropped 600 s after they were last asked, written at most every 10 s, one write at a time (applied when the pod shows it, else timed out after 30 s). The recorded rows do not change with a write. A step: ask (at, stations) or tick (at), the clock in seconds. Per step: the transactions sent and the watch's status (without the operation ID). Inserts are answered with the UUID 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000ff.
